extracted.intended_audience: public relations professionals, corporate communications teams, investor relations officers, and companies seeking press release distribution
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance and feature listing for choosing GlobeNewswire press-release distribution packages across location-based and segment-based circuits, with compliance and translation options for public companies and global audiences.

rubrics_metrics.name: Location-based Distribution
rubrics_metrics.description: Distribute by geographic region (United States, Canada, Europe, Global, Asia, Latin America, Middle East & Africa) and by national or regional circuits.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use location-based packages to reach region-specific media, regulatory authorities, exchanges, and trade publications; combine with social media, online, and traditional publication methods.

rubrics_metrics.name: United States: National
rubrics_metrics.description: Distribute your news across the country using a combination of social media, online, and traditional publication methods.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Premier U.S. National circuit includes electronic distribution to disclosure media, the nation's major newspapers & broadcast media, financial & trade publications, online sites, databases and professional investor desktops. Publicly traded companies can receive disclosure media services that simultaneously distribute to Dow Jones, Thomson Reuters, The Wall Street Journal, The New York Times, Associated Press, United Press International, Moody's Investors Service, Fitch Ratings, Standard & Poor's, Bloomberg, major stock exchanges, and local media outlets. Also distribution to 3,500+ online news outlets such as Nasdaq, Yahoo! Finance, AOL, E*Trade, MarketWatch, NBC News, CNNMoney, Morningstar, USA Today, MSN Money, etc.

rubrics_metrics.name: United States: Regional
rubrics_metrics.description: Target specific U.S. regions, such as the Northeast, West coast, or Midwest.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Share news with regional newslines and targeting trade publications for more localized reach.

rubrics_metrics.name: Canada Distribution and IIROC Compliance
rubrics_metrics.description: Distribute news in English and French across Canada using social, online and traditional publication methods and deliver to stock exchanges and regulatory authorities.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Public companies trading on Canadian exchanges can distribute news and be compliant with the Investment Industry Regulatory Organization of Canada (IIROC) to meet disclosure guidelines; simultaneous distribution to Toronto Stock Exchange, Bloomberg, Canada.com, Financial Post, Globe Investor, MSN Canada, National Post, TSX InfoSuite, and many Canadian newspapers and agencies (Associated Press / Canadian Press, Agence France-Presse, CanWest, BayStreet, etc.).

rubrics_metrics.name: Europe Distribution & EU Transparency Directive Compliance
rubrics_metrics.description: Single country, regional, and pan‑European distribution with partnerships with regional newswires and local news agencies.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Partners include Press Association (UK), AWP (Switzerland), DDP (Germany), AFP (France). Distribution uses precisely targeted lists to reach trade media. Nordic and Baltic distribution works with local regulatory entities to ensure timely delivery of regulatory news and is stated to be in compliance with the EU Transparency Directive.

rubrics_metrics.name: Nordic & Baltic Regulatory Distribution
rubrics_metrics.description: Strong distribution in Nordic and Baltic region via direct partnerships with regional news agencies.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Works directly with Ritzau, Tidningarnas Telegrambyrå, Suomen Tietotoimisto, Norsk Telegrambyrå, Baltic News Service and local exchanges/regulatory entities; described as cost effective, efficient and compliant with EU Transparency Directive; GlobeNewswire positioned as leading provider in the region.

rubrics_metrics.name: Global Distribution Reach
rubrics_metrics.description: Distribute press releases around the world to over 80 countries in 30 local languages via proprietary network and international partners.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes access to Associated Press and proprietary databases; comprehensive coverage of print, broadcast, and online media; direct news feeds to key online portals and financial databases; professional full-text translations; alliances with leading foreign news services/news agencies; targeted distribution to media outlets/journalists by email and fax; customized categories of specific industry trades; and competitive and affordable pricing.

rubrics_metrics.name: Asia Distribution & In-country Translations
rubrics_metrics.description: Distribute to general, financial, and trade media in Asia via partnerships with regional/local newswire providers and news agencies.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Press releases are professionally translated by in-country translation experts and delivered electronically; a variety of single country and distribution packages are available; custom distribution packages can be created. Example destination sites include ADVFN (Japan), BizWire Express (India), Sina (China), Livedoor (Japan), Yahoo! Japan, MSN China, etc.

rubrics_metrics.name: Latin America Distribution & Translations
rubrics_metrics.description: Deliver news to general and financial media in Latin America via partnerships with regional news agencies.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Press releases are professionally translated into Spanish and/or Portuguese and electronically delivered through partners’ distribution networks. Example outlets: IG, UOL, Rede Record, Abril, Globo, Yahoo! Noticias (Mexico), Yahoo! Chile/Argentina/Peru/Colombia.

rubrics_metrics.name: Middle East & Africa Distribution
rubrics_metrics.description: Access mainstream media channels and online media in major Middle Eastern and African countries through local newswire partners.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Partners mentioned include Press Release Network, Noy Tikshoret (Israel), South Africa Press Association; example sites include MENAFN, The Pulse (Israel), Tarbut (Israel).

rubrics_metrics.name: Segment-based Distribution (Industry)
rubrics_metrics.description: Share your message based on specific industries or trades.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Industry categories listed include Healthcare, Banking, Biotechnology, Energy, Technology, Automotive, Entertainment, Environmental, Sports, etc., allowing targeted outreach to trade media and specialist audiences.

rubrics_metrics.name: Segment-based Distribution (Subjects / Themed Circuits)
rubrics_metrics.description: Distribute via subject- or theme-specific circuits tailored to topics or audiences.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Subjects include Search Engine Optimization, Homeland Security, Times Square Newswire, Class Action Newsline, Corporate Social Responsibility, Hispanic Newsline, Radio and Television, etc., useful for topical targeting and audience-specific campaigns.

rubrics_metrics.name: Multimedia Releases
rubrics_metrics.description: Distribution options that include multimedia content to enhance press releases.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Page header references 'Multimedia Releases' and 'multimedia 1,500+' suggesting availability of multimedia distribution to many outlets; use multimedia to increase engagement though detailed mechanics/examples are not provided on this page.

rubrics_metrics.name: Reach & Volume Metrics
rubrics_metrics.description: Quantitative reach indicators for GlobeNewswire's distribution network.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Listed metrics include financial desktops: 1,000,000; websites: 6,000; news publications: 10,000+; wire services: 50; multimedia: 1,500+; trade journals: 50,000+ — use these as expected scale/reach indicators when choosing packages.

rubrics_metrics.name: Professional Translation Services
rubrics_metrics.description: Full-text translations and in-country translation experts to localize press releases for non-English markets.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Mentioned under Global and Asia/Latin America distribution; recommended for reaching local media and ensuring accurate regulatory/market communications.

rubrics_metrics.name: Regulatory & Exchange Disclosure Services
rubrics_metrics.description: Specialized disclosure distribution for publicly traded companies to meet exchange/regulatory distribution requirements.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: U.S. national and Canadian distribution options specifically mention delivering to disclosure media, stock exchanges, and regulatory authorities (e.g., IIROC, local exchanges, major U.S. disclosure channels) to meet disclosure guidelines.

rubrics_metrics.name: Targeted Delivery Methods
rubrics_metrics.description: Delivery via email, fax, direct news feeds, professional investor desktops, and proprietary databases to reach specific audiences.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use targeted delivery to reach journalists, analysts, investors, and online portals; described as part of global offering with direct feeds to key online portals and financial databases.

rubrics_metrics.name: Custom Distribution Packages & Pricing
rubrics_metrics.description: Ability to create custom distribution packages to meet specific communication needs, with competitive and affordable pricing.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Page indicates variety of single-country and distribution packages and willingness to create custom packages tailored to client needs; pricing is described as competitive and affordable.
